page.notes: Greek words are uncertain and marked [?]; the printed Greek is small and partly blurred. The line "Aut ἀξίωσις petitio-ne" and the Greek in the lines with "remotionem", "mitigatione" and "absoluatur" are best readings only. Line-end hyphens kept as printed. Printed "vel" left as is, since it is a consonant form. The text is set as one continuous paragraph with no visible indent, so it is treated as one paragraph continuing from the previous page.
